title: ever JAYCEE|Chic Lace Sheer Back and Cross Straps V-Neck Sleeveless Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning bridesmaid dress features a V-neck with pleated detailing, an A-line shape, and sleeveless cut. The sheer lace back and cross tie straps add a touch of elegance and sophistication to the overall look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
